rows.provider: a provider registered as AndroidKeyStore is installed in process: software keys in app data, not hardware-backed, no attestation
rows.shim: install an "AndroidKeyStore" provider whose keys come from KeyGenParameterSpec and stay per app: software keys in app data (days), or OH HUKS for hardware-backed keys (weeks).
